decisions.reason: The source changes package and bundle price variation, not the existing presentation or classification of individual service prices.
The source is limited to package and bundle prices on the pricing page and does not change the deferred calculator or its existing square-footage tier behavior.
Varying package prices by square footage does not alter the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual tabs.
The pricing-detail navigation entry and destination remain valid unchanged despite the package pricing revision.
The source concerns package pricing and does not change gallery navigation, categories, or organization.
The package pricing revision has no effect on gallery hover animations.
The source changes pricing-page package values and does not alter the homepage visual treatment.
Square-footage-based package pricing does not change the sitewide image-focused design requirement.
The source does not change the requirement to associate listed services with relevant images.
The pricing-page revision has no effect on the homepage gallery animation.
